paragraphs.text: These are books and texts of various forms known to exist in the Multiverse . This list focuses on prayers, stories, songs, poems, memoirs, historical records, and the like that have their own historical or cultural significance. Personal writings, such as letters or diaries, are omitted from this chart so they can be classified as part of the quotations of their writers. Similarly, creeds, notes, or protocols directly pertaining to a specific organization are omitted from here so they can be classified as part of their organization. For the oral history not directly written down, see List of in-multiverse idioms, adages, and proverbs .
